description: This file defines the SecureViewOverlay class, a custom ViewGroup used within the SecureView demonstration activity to overlay and spoof layout positions on other views, obscuring their content as part of the demo behavior.

classes.name: SecureViewOverlay
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that overlays other views and manipulates their layout positions for demonstration purposes.

methods.name: setActivityToSpoof
methods.description: Sets the SecureView activity associated with this overlay for referencing original views.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures child views and determines the size requirements for this ViewGroup.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions overlay views on top of the original views to mimic their layout, effectively spoofing their position on the screen.

methods.name: spoofLayout
methods.description: Calculates position offsets and applies layout to overlay views to mimic the original views' positions.
